text: The Newest Sweets Pack a Punch!
Lefina comes up with the idea to create monsters out of\nsweets together with Filecia to stand against evil\norganizations. Collect the ingredients to help them!
The newly created monster takes an unexpected form and it\nbegins to run wild!\nDefeat the monster, Velcaroy!
[[N]]Collect the ingredients and report to Lefina in Sofya City
